_meta.label: Clear cell carcinoma
_meta.scope: Every efficacy figure is copied from data/trials_occc.json; toxicity from data/tox.json or data/tox_histotypes.json; label rules from data/labels.json or data/labels_histotypes.json. A record with "base" inherits drugs, drug classes, tox_ref, PFS text, risk_rules and ledger_rules from the named HGSC record in data/regimens.json (the regimen's toxicity and label rules do not change with histology); its own keys override.
_meta.tier_reading: Tiers keep the HGSC scheme but are judged on CLEAR CELL evidence. No clear-cell regimen has shown an OS benefit, so tiers 1–3 are empty by construction. Tier 5 = randomised clear-cell (or stratified clear-cell/mucinous) comparison with no efficacy difference, chosen on toxicity (JGOG3017, JGOG-3016, iPocc). Tier 6 = single-arm, pooled-site or all-histology trial in which clear cell was included but not shown to benefit. Tier 7 = no benefit shown in clear cell with added toxicity, or clear cell excluded from the trial.

regimens.name: Observation after complete staging (no adjuvant chemotherapy)

os.median: ICON1 + ACTION clear cell subgroup (deaths only, n=130): 16/68 chemotherapy vs 17/62 observation — the pooled early-stage benefit is not visible in clear cell; histology interaction P=.55. Bogani 2020 (observational, stage I): no OS effect overall, stage IC OS OR 0.70

pfs.text: Bogani: no DFS effect (P=0.86); stage IC DFS OR 0.77 (0.41–1.43), NS

qualifiers: Clear cell deaths in ICON1/ACTION 16/68 (chemo) vs 17/62 (observation): the pooled early-stage benefit is not visible in the clear cell counts
ACTION's benefit was confined to incompletely staged patients; this record assumes complete staging
The vault note reserves chemotherapy for stage IC and above; stage IA/IB is where observation is defensible

prefer_when.reason: Stage I: no DFS/OS effect of adjuvant chemotherapy in the clear-cell–only meta-analysis (Bogani 2020)

risk_rules.reason: Stage II: the Bogani meta-analysis covered stage I only; ACTION/ICON1 admitted stage II and favoured chemotherapy trial-wide
